svg.title: Input images, reasoning boxes, CAD consolidation output
svg.desc: The figure has a dashed input-images frame at the top containing four visual inputs: a technical drawing, a profiled part drawing, a front-face/section drawing, and a rendered triangular-prism CAD part. Three rounded reasoning boxes below contain wrong answers from different agents, connected from the input frame by arrows. A CME-CAD robot sits centrally below the boxes and feeds a corrected green final answer panel at the bottom. All frames are reconstructed as editable SVG with stable IDs.

g.desc: Left input: dimensioned orthographic sketch with a rectangular stepped profile and dimension annotations.
Second input: source-matching side/profile view with symmetric lower notch, side scallops, circular hole, and R3 slanted dimension.
Third input: rectangular front-face drawing with separated source-style bottom dimension labels.
